# hyperlite_storage_volume (Resource)

A blank volume of a storage pool (a qcow2 file, or a zvol on ZFS), to keep data apart from a VM. A disk of `hyperlite_vm` makes its own; use this for a volume that outlives its VMs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hyperlite_storage_volume" "data" {
  storage_pool = hyperlite_storage_pool.fast.name
  name         = "data"
  size_gb      = 100
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Its name (`.qcow2` is added on a file pool).
- `size_gb` (Number) Its size in GB (a change replaces it: grow a VM's disk through `hyperlite_vm`).
- `storage_pool` (String) Its storage pool.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<storage_pool>/<volume>`.
- `path` (String) Its path on the node.
- `volume` (String) Its name in the pool, as `hyperlite_vm`'s attach takes it.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import hyperlite_storage_volume.data fast/data.qcow2
```
